title: Harrison Barrett and the Monteleone broadcast
summary: Harrison Barrett played with Williams for a long time, and Williams recalls the radio broadcast at the Monteleone and the advertising wagon with a five-piece band.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: And what about, Harrison was playing some around with you then, Harrison Barrett?
Yeah Harrison Barrett, he played with me a long time. He played with me and Rick Hall. At that old point now he made more money with me and that album.
Well what about, you said you played at the Monteleon, what kind of job was that?
That was a broadcast that night. Broadcast for Dick and Potato Chip.

Yeah. See they had this open up over there, bought that place, Lichtenfield Street. We advertised in the wagon and then I had to have a piano player for that night because it told me to be sure to get a piano player for that night. You know? Yeah. So that was Harris Barrett and Joe Phillip, Trumpet, me, Fat, and I had five pieces. Back to Bump, before I forget it, didn't you all play at the St. Charles Hotel? Yeah. Who was it? Was it a party or what? No. No. They had a party or what?
